changes: Substring search retries a byte that rejected the preceding candidates when letter frequencies change. Short binary64 decimals use bounded integer division. On x86-64, the AVX2 paths scan short, page-contained strings directly, scan longer strings in 256-byte blocks, and use fixed displacements for successive memory comparisons.
overview_scope: The record parser is a synthetic workload. The 64 KiB substring controls have their own input shapes and timing loops.
